function.description: Close (retire) a position-book row whose tokens are GONE or DUST (worth under $1). Measures the wallet's balance on chain itself and refuses unless it is zero or dust; the measurement is stored as proof. Moves nothing. A holding worth more is sold, or the owner writes it off.
function.name: defi_data_retire_row

address.description: The token contract / mint address of the book row

chain.description: The chain the book row is on (base, robinhood, solana, …)
